name: Furiosa
desc: A Volkodlak archer who once nearly lost her life. After undergoing alchemical modification, her body's strength surpassed the limits of living beings, and she gained a measure of authority over trees. She was meant to cast off her former body and fully transform into a life-form beyond time, one closer to eternity. But at the final moment, she chose to abandon that path. And so, she remains in a state as though her body has been parasitized by trees.
